messages.subject: Boucle -broke on back pack cooler
messages.text:
Bonjour!

 I ordered TWO backpack coolers and received them a few weeks
 ago. 

 

 Order L-15897

 

 I was a bit worried about the plastic buckle and zut - it broke
 the FIRST time I brought the pack to a music festival.

 a Metal buckle would have been a better choice?!

 I have given the 2nd backpack to my sister - I'm not sure if
 she's used it yet, but I warned her about the buckle.

 I love the look of the backpack and the enviro benefits - and
 supporting a QC enterprise. 

 

 Have other people had this problem? What do you suggest we do? I
 wish now I'd chosen the insulated shopping bags : }

 

 I'm attaching a photo.

 Merci - 

 

 Anne

 

 -- 
Anne Winship
Café Bean Fair Coffee
819 962 4440
www.beanfair.ca (http://www.beanfair.ca)

‘Sometimes the longest journey a human being can take 
is from their head to their heart.’
Paul Allaire, Métis Firekeeper

messages.text:
Hi Anne,
 

 Unfortunately, you're not the only one; we've encountered this issue with a few coolers.
 

 We're offering to send you new, more durable parts that won't break, starting from this week.
 

 Does this suit you?
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Raphael 
 Administrative assistant 
 Lasclay
